final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Signal: frontend (entry caller) logs 567x of 'could not retrieve product: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = no product with ID 6E92ZMYYFZ' on GET /product/{id}, with alert 'frontend ERROR_SPIKE [Success Rate Drop] Normal=90.5% -> Cur=65.9%' and 'recommendationservice AVAILABILITY_MISSING success_rate vanished'. The failing edge is frontend -> productcatalogservice, and the reply is a gRPC NotFound from the callee (connectivity fine, so not DNS/endpoint/selector). Workload is healthy: pods listing shows productcatalogservice-68b9c7b49-zwvdk 2/2 Running 0 RESTARTS, all 11 services Running/Ready (excludes scheduling, image-pull, quota, probe classes; deployment replicas=1 in GetAppYAML). productcatalogservice's own error log is empty and it is a leaf (no downstream callee). Code surface: product_catalog.go GetProduct has its MATCH branch doing 'if productID == product.Id { return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "no product with ID %s", productID) }' plus the same NotFound after the loop, so a request whose ID IS present in the catalog is rejected by the handler's own return path and the error echoes the supplied id (6E92ZMYYFZ) - a wrong return value, not a missing parameter; catalog_loader.go products.json load and ListProducts/SearchProducts are intact. Namespace events show only rollout/setup history (ScalingReplicaSet churn, FailedCreate serviceaccount-not-found lines each followed by SuccessfulCreate; the productcatalogservice ServiceAccount exists in the manifest) - no FailedScheduling/FailedMount/image-pull mechanism. Conclusion: root cause is a wrong-return defect in productcatalogservice's GetProduct handler on app/productcatalogservice; frontend 500s and recommendationservice data loss are downstream echoes.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: productcatalogservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: productcatalogservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: productcatalogservice
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
        image: wangyl2128/productcatalogservice-v2:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3550
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "3550"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
  labels:
    app: productcatalogservice
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: productcatalogservice
  ports:
  - name: grpc
    port: 3550
    targetPort: 3550
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: productcatalogservice
  namespace: boutique
